RevolvingUtilizationOfUnsecuredLines: Proportion of revolving balances to credit limits is too high
age: Limited length of established credit history
NumberOfTime30-59DaysPastDueNotWorse: Too many recent past-due payment delinquencies (30–59 days)
DebtRatio: Monthly debt obligations are too high relative to gross income
NumberOfOpenCreditLinesAndLoans: Insufficient number of active, established credit lines
NumberOfTimes90DaysLate: Serious delinquency history (account 90 or more days past due)
NumberRealEstateLoansOrLines: Lack of established first mortgage or real estate loan history
NumberOfTime60-89DaysPastDueNotWorse: Repeated delinquent payments (60–89 days past due)
NumberOfDependents: High household dependent obligations relative to income capacity
